reason: Article 8 of the DORA Delegated Regulation establishes the requirement for ICT risk management and incident reporting, which is a continuous process. The mapping to this article provides a defensible and sufficiently complete regulatory basis for the control objective of performing the activity continuously.
applicability_note: This control is applicable to all financial entities and groups subject to DORA, as Article 8 is a core requirement of the regulation.
challenge_comment: The challenge is to ensure that the continuous nature of the control is demonstrably linked to the ongoing requirements of Article 8, rather than being interpreted as a one-time or periodic task.
